selected_backend.reason: Reuse the already declared and licensed numerical stack while keeping the optimizer algorithm and evidence contract under repository control.

rejected_expansion.reason: S3 does not justify another runtime dependency before the frozen baselines and adapter evidence establish the required behavior.

isolation_gates: load the uncertainty-aware backend only on an explicit research path
keep ordinary MCP discovery free of NumPy and SciPy imports
bind backend version, normalized history, seed, and acquisition settings into checkpoints
reject nonfinite uncertainty, duplicate candidates, and out-of-domain acquisition results
prove deterministic replay and multi-seed improvement before campaign promotion
implementation_boundary: An S5 feature must implement and independently gate the selected backend before any licensed autonomous campaign uses it.
